sloka: सज्जी भवन्तु प्लवगाः शिबिक वाहन उचिताः ।समर्था बलिनः चैव निर्हरिष्यन्ति वालिनम् ॥४-२५-१८॥
transliteration: sajjī bhavantu plavagāḥ śibika vāhana ucitāḥ ।samarthā balinaḥ caiva nirhariṣyanti vālinam ॥4-25-18॥

translations.english: 'Let those who are strong and capable among the monkeys be ready to carry the dead body of Vali on a litter'.
